title: VIX futures May 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — on a TUESDAY, pulled off its usual Wednesday by the Juneteenth closure 30 days later
source: EST: TWO Cboe primary surfaces re-fetched direct 2026-09-05 by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 initial research. (1) cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes) carries a live contract row rendered `"VX/K7", " - ", "2027-05-18"` with real daily settlement prices against it (21.15 on 2026-09-04, 21.325 on 2026-09-03). (2) The machine-readable endpoint www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) independently returns `VX,VX/K7,2027-05-18,21.15`. Arithmetic cross-check: VIX futures AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation exactly 30 calendar days before the SPX expiration they reference, and 2027-05-18 + 30 days = 2027-06-17 — the June 2027 expiration as displaced off the third Friday (2027-06-18) by the Juneteenth closure, filed the same day as opex-2027-06-17. The same 30-day rule reproduces the surrounding, undisplaced strip: VX/H7 2027-03-17 -> 2027-04-16 and VX/J7 2027-04-21 -> 2027-05-21, both unadjusted third Fridays. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep; `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under (it is what promoted vix-expiration-2026-09-16, -2027-03-17 and -2027-04-21) and the evidence is already at that standard. Checked 2026-09-05
notes: PROPOSED by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 initial research (2026-09-05). WHY A CLOSURE 31 DAYS LATER GETS TO PROPOSE THIS: the date is not adjacent to that closure, it is CAUSED by it, and it is the closure's cleanest independent corroboration. Every other listed VX contract settles on a Wednesday (VX/U6 2026-09-16, V6 2026-10-21, X6 2026-11-18, Z6 2026-12-16, F7 2027-01-20, G7 2027-02-17, H7 2027-03-17, J7 2027-04-21, all verified by weekday arithmetic this session); VX/K7 is the one Tuesday on the strip, and it is a Tuesday for exactly one reason — its 30-day SPX reference moved from Friday 2027-06-18 to Thursday 2027-06-17 when NYSE closed for Juneteenth. A reader who does not know that will read the Tuesday as a data error. WHY IT WAS NOT ALREADY FILED: the vix-expiration-2027-04-21 lane recorded the VX/K7 row verbatim in its own notes on 2026-09-05 (correcting an earlier sibling's claim that the CSV was missing it — a parse artifact, not a Cboe gap) but proposed no entry for it, and the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 lane declined the neighbouring J7 as out of corridor. The row is therefore already double-recorded in this repo and was still not on the calendar. THE ONE STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE, recorded so a later pulse need not re-derive it: this contract's 30-day window runs 2027-05-18 -> 2027-06-17 and CONTAINS fomc-2027-06-09 (high, estimate) and boj-decision-2027-06-11 (medium, estimate) — but the vix-expiration-2027-04-21 initial research already tested and REFUSED the FOMC-in-strip premium on this same curve (log days-to-expiry explains 97.4% of its cross-section; the residual after duration is the wrong sign and not sign-stable), so 'the strip contains a decision' is NOT re-proposed here as a reason to expect anything. Impact LOW: it supports one execution guard — nothing trades the 2027-05-18 opening auction, where the SOQ's first prints are artifacts rather than information — and licenses nothing. No house playbook is opex- or vol-settlement-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05, zero hits). Estimate widens caution only.
